verdict.rationale: First-party docs say Fireworks serves its text models through OpenAI-compatible APIs. They describe it as a drop-in replacement for OpenAI with the same API, and say tool calling uses OpenAI-compatible tool specifications. Clients just point at api.fireworks.ai, so an agent can switch providers by changing the base URL and model ID. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that switching works without code changes; documentation of compatibility edge cases (e.g., provider-specific parameters like service_tier, Fast model-ID variants, x-session-affinity header) and any feature-parity gaps.
